description: The image is a plan-view diagram titled "Diagram 2.8 Wall type 1 – position of openings in masonry inner leaf of external cavity wall". On the left, the label "Separating wall" is positioned in an area bounded by a vertical line on the right and two angled lines on the left. A horizontal double-headed arrow labelled "x" measures the distance from this vertical line to a rectangle. The rectangle is labelled below as "Masonry inner leaf of external cavity wall". A vertical double-headed arrow labelled "y" spans the rectangle from its top edge to its bottom edge. Above the rectangle, text reads "x not more than 700mm and y not less than 1m". On the far right, a vertical line with zigzag break marks indicates the wall continues beyond the drawing.
